entities.name: Agathon Fabergé

entities.summary: Agathon Karlovich Fabergé was a Russian goldsmith and philatelist. He was the second son of Peter Carl Fabergé. In 1927, he fled the Soviet Union and settled in Finland, where he obtained a Nansen passport and resided until his death.

entities.summary: Agathon Karlovich Fabergé was a Russian goldsmith and philatelist. He was the second son of Peter Carl Fabergé. In 1927, he fled the Soviet Union and settled in Finland, where he obtained a Nansen passport and resided until his death.
